(7) One woman holds the product close to the lens while text overlays with discount codes and promotional graphics populate the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, authoritative child's voice giving directions, accompanied by a light paper rustle. A fast-tempo synth-pop BGM with a strong kick drum starts immediately. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition leads to two female voices counting rhythmically '5 6 7 8' followed by high-arousal chanting of 'bomb bomb bomb' in sync with the beat. (3) A loud shouting vocal from the child PD occurs, marked by an 'impact' sound effect, cutting into the music temporarily to emphasize frustration. (4) The music swells as the female voices return, singing about 'moisture power' with high vocal valence. Frequent 'ding' and cartoon 'boing' SFX are layered over the speech. (5) The master track transitions into a clear, professional narrative tone from the main female speaker, describing product benefits over the continuous electronic BGM. (6) A final 'ding' SFX coincides with the presentation of the brand name and a promotional coupon code mentioned with high intensity.
